lines.japanese: よし、やっぱり日和子さんも誘おう。
lines.english: All right. I would invite Hiyoko after all.

lines.japanese: 愛しのハニーを前にして、声もかけずに他の女とさようなら。なんてそんなんできるか！
lines.english: Could I stand before my beloved honey, never even ask her, and leave with another woman? Hell no!

lines.japanese: 「ていうわけだから、日和子さんも一緒に行きましょうよ。アレキサンダーの前に軽く寄るぐらいの時間はありますよね」
lines.english: “So that's the situation. Come with us, Hiyoko. You have time for a quick stop before Alexander, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「顔色、窺う窺う」
lines.english: “Checking her mood, checking her mood.”

lines.japanese: 後ろから入った茶々は無視。
lines.english: I ignored the heckling from behind.

lines.japanese: 「どっすか日和子さん、なんだったら、ちょっと遅れるって店に電話でも入れとけば──」
lines.english: “What do you say, Hiyoko? If necessary, you could call the restaurant and say you'll be a little late—”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、それは」
lines.english: “No, I couldn't.”

lines.japanese: 苦い表情で首を振る真面目な日和子さん。
lines.english: Serious Hiyoko shook her head with a pained expression.

lines.japanese: ま、そうおっしゃるとは思ってましたけどね。なにせ他人にも自分にも厳しいひとですし、そんなところにも不真面目な俺は惹かれたわけです。
lines.english: I had expected as much. She was strict with herself and others alike, and that was one reason an irresponsible man like me had fallen for her.

lines.japanese: 「すみません。バイトには余裕を持って入りたいので、折角ですが今回は」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. I prefer to arrive at work with time to spare, so I appreciate the invitation, but not today.”

lines.japanese: 「悪いね玉泉。どうしても気になるゲームでさ。今日のところは見逃して」
lines.english: “Sorry, Tamaizumi. I absolutely have to see this game. Let it slide today.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　べつに気にしてませんけど？」
lines.english: “What? It doesn't bother me in the slightest.”

lines.japanese: 軽く笑いとばした日和子さんが、かえって強がってるみたいに見えたのは気のせいでしょうか。
lines.english: Was it my imagination, or did Hiyoko's breezy laugh make her look as though she were putting on a brave face?

lines.japanese: そして間。
lines.english: Then came a pause.

lines.japanese: ビミョーな空気。
lines.english: Awkward tension.

lines.japanese: 誰が最初にこの場を去るのか、誰が最後に取りのこされるのか、さながら牽制しあうような一瞬。
lines.english: For an instant, we seemed to be testing one another: who would leave first, and who would be left behind last?

lines.japanese: こんな状況、以前の俺だったらとっとと一人で逃げだしてただろうなあ。勇気をありがとう、肝の据わった兄弟たち。
lines.english: The old me would have fled alone at once. Thank you for the courage, my stouthearted brothers.

lines.japanese: 「それじゃあ──」
lines.english: “In that case—”

lines.japanese: 膠着しててもしょうがない、ここはぬるぬる鷲介が動きましょう。
lines.english: Standing around in a deadlock solved nothing. It was time for Slippery Shuusuke to act.

lines.japanese: 「──明日香さん、うちらは三十分後にグローヴ街の入口集合ってことで」
lines.english: “—Asuka, let's meet at the entrance to Grove Street in thirty minutes.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　いったん解散すんの？」
lines.english: “Hm? We're splitting up first?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、すいません。俺このまま日和子さんをアレキサンダーまで送りたいんで」
lines.english: “Yes, sorry. I'm going to walk Hiyoko to Alexander.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ、いいですよそんな……！」
lines.english: “You don't have to do that...!”

lines.japanese: 「よくない」
lines.english: “Yes, I do.”

lines.japanese: いまさら逃げようとする彼女を捕まえて、ぐいと引きよせました。
lines.english: I caught her as she tried to escape at this late stage and pulled her firmly toward me.

lines.japanese: 「一緒に帰ろうって言ってくれたじゃないすか。彼氏にぬか喜びさせないでください」
lines.english: “You asked me to walk back with you, didn’t you? Don’t get your boyfriend’s hopes up for nothing.”

lines.japanese: 肩を抱きよせられる形になって日和子さんはひどく恥ずかしがっていましたが、俺は構わず密着したまま歩きだしました。
lines.english: Hiyoko was terribly embarrassed to find herself tucked beneath my arm, but I ignored that and began walking with our bodies still pressed together.

lines.japanese: 不安や孤独から姫を守り、お城までエスコートするのが王子さまの務めです。
lines.english: A prince's duty was to protect his princess from fear and loneliness and escort her safely to her castle.

lines.japanese: 「そいじゃ明日香さん、またあとで～」
lines.english: “See you later, Asuka!”

lines.japanese: 「お、お先に失礼します……ちょ、鷲介さん離れてくださいっ」
lines.english: “E-excuse us... Wait, Shuusuke, let go of me!”

lines.japanese: 「えー、もうちょっといいじゃないすか、あははー」
lines.english: “Aww, just a little longer. Ahaha!”

lines.japanese: 遠ざかってゆく幸せそうな恋人たちを見送って、あとに残されたクラスメイトが低く呻いていました。
lines.english: Watching the happy couple recede, the classmate left behind gave a low groan.

lines.japanese: 「……反吐が出るよね」
lines.english: “...It makes me sick.”
